highlights: Model   StarLink Wi-C046E C-C + Lightning + Micro-USB
Max Power Output   Up to 60 W
Material & Build   Reinforced TPE / braided jacket
Data Support   Fast data transfer + charging
3-in-1 Connector Set (C-C + Lightning + Micro USB) — The Wi-C046E works with practically everything: modern USB-C phones & laptops, older Micro-USB devices, and iPhones with Lightning.
60 W High Power Delivery — Charge laptops, tablets, phones fast with up to 60 Watts via USB-C; keeps charging efficient across all supported devices.
Fast Data Transmission — Built to support both charging & high-speed data swap between devices.
Durable TPE Braided Design — Strong and flexible, the Wi-C046E is reinforced to resist daily bends, pulls, and wear-and-tear.
1-Meter Length — Ideal balance of reach and convenience for desk use, travel, or bedside charging without excess cable clutter.
